tei:div.tei:p: "‚ &!"#$%&༄༅// bka' brgyud mgur mtsho'i go don khog dbubs spyi chings rnam par

bshad pa skal bzang yid kyi ngal gso zhes bya ba bzhugs so// '$ 'o na bkra shis bde legs dang ldan par gyur cig /rgyal ba kun gyi blo gros gcig bsdus pa// mgon po gsung gi dbang phyug zhing rgya mtshor// dbyangs kyi yan lag 'byams klas rnam 'gyur gyis// chos 'khor yongs 'doms bka' brgyud mchog la 'dud// sgrub la brtson pa'i shugs drag pas// mngon par rtogs pa mchog brnyes te// grub pa'i dbang phyug kun gyi rje// bzhad pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// de la gangs can gyi ljongs chen po 'dir gang la zhugs pas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi gzhal med khang du gdon mi za bar 'jug pa/ rdo rje theg pa'i gdams ngag zab dgu thang mar brdal nas 'doms par mdzad pas/ snying po'i don gyi bstan pa ma dros pa'i mtsho ltar rgyas pa'i dpal 'dzin pa la mtshungs zla ma mchis pa ni/ mnga' bdag mar pa'i bka' brgyud rin po che zhes 'jig rten gsum du snyan grags kyi rnga bo ches khyab pa 'di nyid yin la/ de yang bcos ma'i 'ching ba thams cad glang po'i khyu mchog gis 'dam bu'i tshal ltar brdzis/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'tshang rgya bar gang nas byon pa'i shul lam chen po mdzub tshugs su bstan/ slob ris su gtogs so cog thams cad kyang chos brgyad kyi thal ba rlung la bskur/ ri'i bu byas/ na bun gyi gos gyon/ lto gos gtam gsum la gyong bskur/ lus 'du 'dzi/ ngag bre mo/ sems rnam rtog las dben pa'i mtshams po che legs par bcad nas/ stan thog gcig tu spang la be phur btab pa ltar sdod tshugs/ des bla mas bstan pa'i gdams ngag gi bdud rtsi snying la bzhag nas brgal dka' srid pa'i ra ba thog pa med par bral te/ zung 'jug rdo rje'i go 'phang zhes bya ba'i ming snyan po can der song ba la rtsod pa med pas/ grub thob gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed sngar byon/ phyis 'byon par 'gyur/ da lta 'byon bzhin pa 'di ka lags la/

de lta bas na sngon byon pa grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba de dag gis e waṃ zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi sdom pa mngon du mdzad pa'i nyams skyugs/ rdo rje'i mgur rnams grub pa'i skye bo gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de gsung rgyun ma nyams par 'phel ba'i dbyangs kyi rta las drangs te len pa'i 'di'i khungs kyang*/ spyir bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor lo zab rgyas mtha' dag kyang*/ gsung chos kyi dung grub pa'i dpal gyi mgul nas dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtshos bsnyad pa dang*/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi ya rgyal gcig dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i sder grags shing grub pa dang*/ 'dul ba'i sde snod rnams las kyang*/ rgyun chags gsum pa dbyangs kyi nga ro dang bcas te gdon par bya'o// zhes 'byung zhing*/ sangs rgyas phal po che'i chos kyi rnam grangs rgyal sras kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po las/ de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad kyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// zhes gsungs pa sogs theg pa che chung gi sde snod du ma nas dkon mchog bstod pa'i sgra dbyangs dang*/ dam pa'i chos kyi sgo du ma dbyangs kyi nga ro dang snyan pa'i gdangs kyis 'don pa dang*/ gdon pa dang*/ nye bar ston pa dang*/ lung 'bogs pa dang*/ kha ton bgyi bar gsungs shing*/ khyad par zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i yang rtse rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rab 'byams rnams las tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dga' ston gyi tshe rdo rje'i glu blangs pa'i rnam bzhag mtha' yas pa zhig byung ba/ dpes mtshon na/ dgyes rdor rtsa rgyud brtag pa phyi ma'i le'u bzhi par/ rdo rje chos dang sangs rgyas dang*// rnal 'byor ma dang ma mo yis// glu dang gar ni 'di dag gis// legs par glu blangs gar yang bya// zhes dang*/

he ru ka 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ glu dang gar dang spyod pa kun// rgyal ba'i mdzad par ma gyur med// ces gsungs pa sogs dpag tu med do// de yang rgya gar 'phags yul du rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brgyad dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'du ba gcig tu spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag gi do ha rdo rje'i mgur sngon gyi lo paṇa skyes mchog bka' drin can rnams kyis bod du bsgyur ba ji snyed mngon sum du bzhugs pas kyang shes la/ khyad par bka' brgyud rin po che'i rtogs pa rdo rje'i mgur 'di dag ni thos pa tsam gyis dad pa'i dran pa gso/ yid ches kyi nges shes bskyed/ nyams kyi ngar lhung*/ rtogs pa'i dpa' bskyed/ mdor na rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i nying khu/ mkhas grub bye ba'i dgongs don/ mkha' 'gro 'bum sde'i snying khrag /thar lam gsal ba'i sgron me/ skal ldan dbang rnon thos pa'i mod la 'ching ba thams cad las rnam par grol te da lta rang 'tshang rgya nus pa sha stag lags so// de lta bu'i mgur gyi spyi chings la don lnga ste/ mgur len pa'i dgos pa/ mgur blangs pa'i dus/ mgur ji ltar blangs pa/ mgur len dus kyi bsam pa/ mgur spyi dang bye brag gi don no// de la dang po mgur len pa'i dgos pa ni/ phyi rol gdon gyi bar chad/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi bar chad/ ting nge 'dzin sems kyi bar chad gsum gyi g.yul las rgyal zhing*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma thams cad kyis mel tshe byed pas dge ba'i phyogs mtha' dag rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur/ gnas skabs su tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ ral gri la sogs pa'i grub pa brgyad 'thob/ snang ba dbang du 'du/ snyan pas phyogs bcur khyab/ phrin las 'dod dgur bsgyur/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad padma'i mtsho la ngang pa ltar 'du/

zhen chags med kyang longs spyod kyi char 'bab/ lam gong ma gong ma'i yon tan 'bad med du skye zhing chos nyid kyi don rtogs/ mthar thug phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob pa'o// gnyis pa mgur blangs pa'i dus ni/ rtsa ba'am brgyud pa'i bla ma'i dus chen dang*/ rgyal ba'i dus chen bzhi sogs dang*/ dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub cing mchod pa la 'jug cing dbang blangs ba'i rjes thob/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ thun mtshams dang*/ skyo bseng dang*/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa byed pa'i dus la sogs par len pa'o// gsum pa mgur ji ltar blangs pa'i tshul ni/ lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur yin te lus kyi las su bka' brgyud rin po che'i rigs kyi dbang rtags sgom zhwa brjid chags dang*/ chos gos rnam gsum gyon/ lus gnad rnam par snang mdzad kyi chos bdun bcas te len/ ngag gi las su byin rlabs don gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams gyi gsung rgyun nyams pa med pa/ slob dpon mkhas pa dag gi zhal las legs par bslabs pa/ 'gal 'khrul nor ba'i skyon dang bral ba/ dad 'dus nyan pa po rnams kyang snang ba chos su bsgyur ba/ byin rlabs kyi zil chen 'bebs pa/ nyams rtogs rtsol med du skye ba/ rna bar snyan cing yid la 'bab par len pa'o// bzhi pa mgur len pa'i dus kyi bsam pa ni/ yid kyi las te/ thog mar dbang gi ye shes dran par byas la cung zad gzengs bstod de gsol ba btab pa gcig pus 'khor 'das kyi bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ bka' brgyud yid bzhin nor bu la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang*/ byams snying rje byang chub sems kyis kun nas bslang ste snang ba dang mi snang ba'i sems can nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa dag la chos kyi sbyin pa btang ba dang*/ lus lha ngag sngags sems chos nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gsum dang ma bral zhing*/

khyad par rig stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ting nge 'dzin las ma g.yos par len pa'o// lnga pa mgur spyi dang bye brag gi don ni/ yid ches mos gus bskyed pa lo rgyus rnam thar/ thar lam snang bar byed pa drang don rgyu 'bras/ rnam mkhyen 'bras bu'i dngos rgyu kun rdzob byang sems/ zhu bde lhan skyes ngo sprod pa bde stong phyag chen/ rang rig lhan skyes mdzub tshugs su ston pa gnas lugs phyag chen sogs mdor na rgyal ba'i gsung rab 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las byung ba'i mar gyi snying po lta bu sha stag yin pas/ gong ma'i gsung yig rnying khung thub sor bzhag ste/ ngag gi lam nas lhag chad med par bsgrags pa nyid las su zhig gis spobs/ gzhan yang snga rabs pa'i gsung sgros la/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen pos chos nyid gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi mgur du gsungs/ bde mchog 'khor lo tai lo pas zung 'jug lhan skyes kyi ye shes ngo sprod du gsungs/ rdo rje sems dpa' nā ro ta pas 'byung ba ro snyoms kyi gdams ngag tu gsungs/ dgyes mdzad lo tsā chen pos bsre 'pho mtshams sbyor gyi zab don du gsungs/ gsang ba 'dus pa mi la chen pos rlung sems dbyer med kyi man ngag tu gsungs/ gsung gi rdo rje sgam po pas ting 'dzin zhi mchog gi lam srol du gsungs/ log par dad sel phag mo gru pa dang*/ drug pa seng ge rgyal mchog dus gsum mkhyen pa sogs bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyis stong nyid rten 'brel gyi chos tshul dang*/ mos gus rtogs pa ro mnyam/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug /rgyu 'bras dbyer med/ mi rtag nges 'byung zhen log /bla ma rang sems dbyer med/ gegs sel bogs 'don sogs kyi nyams mgur ci rigs par gsungs/ de dag ni gtso che ba'am mtshon pa tsam ste/ rje btsun chen po mi las mgur chen khri tsho gcig dang drug stong gsungs pa'i khri phrag gcig po mkha' 'gros 'og min du spyan drangs/

stong tsho drug phyi rabs slob brgyud kyi don du bzhags skad na/ de dag gi tshig don gyi pha mtha' su zhig gis 'dzin par nus/ de las mnyam med dwags po'i bka' brgyud pa so so rang rang gi don brgyud kyi phyag bzhes mgur chen gyi khrigs ka ci rigs par bzhugs mod/ 'dir sgrub brgyud rin po che karma kaṃ tshang bar sngon gyi phyag bzhes nyams med kyi khar/ rje brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje dga' ba'i dbyangs can gyis rje nyid kyi gsungs dbyangs 'ga' zhig gtso bor byas nas bka' brgyud gong ma dag gis gsung mgur kha shas shig 'grigs chags su bkod de dbyangs tshig thams cad la dag ther dang bcas rgyas par spel te/ de la sa bcad kyang dang po gsol 'debs mchod bstod dang bcas nas mgur gyi sna 'dren/ bar du lo rgyus byung khungs dang bcas nas mgur gyi khog dbubs/ tshigs bcad 'bru gnon dang bcas nas mgur gyi gsal btab/ dus tshod gnas skabs dang bstun nas mgur gyi mtshams sbyar/ mthar tshogs 'khor bkra shis smon lam dang bcas nas mgur gyi cho ga bsdu dgos zhes gsungs pa'i phyag len ltar rim bzhin spel ba mos pa lags so/ / zhes pas mtshams sbyar ba'am/ de las bsdus par mos na/ ༈ oṃ swa sti/ rgyal ba mchog gi snying po don gyi bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad pa la/ 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba bka' brgyud rin po che zhes 'jig rten gsum du snyan par grags shing*/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba zab mo phyag rgya chen po'i sgo nas lus 'ja' lus dang*/ sems chos kyi skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i skyes bu'i khyu mchog de rnams kyis/ gdul bya so so'i skal ba dang mtshams par thos grol rtogs tshad rdo rje'i glu rim pa 'byams klas pa zhig gsungs pa las/ 'dir mos gus kyi gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ rnam par thar pa la nges shes bskyed pa dang*/ 'khor ba la zhen pa bzlog pa dang*/

nyams rtogs kyi yon tan la bogs dbyung ba sogs kyi ched du rags pa tsam brjod na/ zhes gleng bslangs te/ gsung mgur so so'i gong bshad brjod de dbyangs 'then par bya'o// mthar tshogs 'khor gyi rim pa bcas legs par grub nas/ bkra shis rgyas par spel zhing*/ theg pa chen po'i smon lam gyis mtha' rgyas par bya'o// 'di yang mang thos dad brtson dang ldan pa// dbang gsum la gnas bka' brgyud pa rnams dang*// nyams rtogs bogs 'don rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs kyi// go don khog dbubs legs par bshad pa ste// 'di bris dge bas 'jig rten khams rnams su// sgrub brgyud bstan pas 'gro kun smin grol shog// /
